div.head: Iud Dei XII 21.2
div.ab: ut creatura mysteriis tuis seruiens ad diabolicas et humanas fallacias detegendas et ad earum multiplicia figmenta et argumenta dissoluenda atque ad multiformes earum artes destruendas diuinę gratię sumat effectum.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 422 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: that the creature serving your mysteries may receive the effect of divine grace for uncovering diabolical and human deceits, and for dissolving their manifold fictions and arguments, and for destroying their many-formed arts.
